cohort: 5,484 women aged 30-49 years who underwent endometrial ablation
finding: Endometrial ablation was not associated with an increased risk of endometrial or breast cancer but was linked to a fourfold higher risk of subsequent hysterectomy, particularly in women with leiomyomas, younger age, and a history of cesarean deliveries or sterilization.
mod_finding: Women with at least two prior cesarean deliveries had a 27% higher risk of undergoing post-ablation hysterectomy compared to those with fewer or no previous cesarean deliveries.
